text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkish foreign minister says Iraq's oil will start flowing during the next few weeks.
- Iraq and Turkey hold talks in Ankara on the transportation of food and medicine to Iraq in accordance with the oil-for-food deal it signed with the U.N..
- Iraq's foreign minister reiterates in New York his country's rejection of no-fly zones in its north and south set by the U.S. and its allies.
- Iraqi chambers of commerce federation sign a cooperation agreement with the Iraqi-Belgian trade and industry commission.
- Iraq to be represented in the world labour conference that will be held in Geneva.
(The above stories were also carried by THAWRA)
- Washington talks (between the Palestinains and Israelis) have failed.
- A Russian official delegation to visit Iraq next month.
